description: This file declares utility functions for Base64 encoding and decoding within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It provides interface declarations for encoding data to a Base64 string and decoding a Base64 string to a binary buffer.

methods.name: EncodeBase64
methods.description: Encodes arbitrary binary data pointed to by '_data' of length 'size' into a Base64 string, output to 'out'.

methods.name: DecodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string 'data' into a binary buffer stored in 'buffer'.
